What decided it was a radius-7 "commuter" design released at tick 1000. It steers up the sugar gradient when hungry and heads off toward mineral when full, which fixed the early problem of organisms sitting at sugar vents with full energy but no material to divide. That lineage took over my population and held roughly 7,000–8,500 biomass from tick 3000 to the end.

- **Larger, more efficient bodies:** every attempt to seed a radius 8–10 lineage after tick 2500 failed, because those founders found almost no sugar before starving.
- **Late budget:** the last six windows' budget went on more radius-7 commuter founders, which added little since my own population was already competing for the same sugar.
